social_circle.name: Rajesh Mehta

demographics.occupation: IT systems analyst for an auto supplier
demographics.education: Bachelor's degree in computer information systems

background.how_they_met: They met through the Gujarati Indian-American community as young adults and married when Shoba was in her twenties.
background.why_close: They have been married for 27 years, share household finances and parenting, and balance each other's temperaments: Rajesh is quieter and patient while Shoba manages calendars and logistics.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Concise, practical texts with full sentences. He is more likely to acknowledge a message with a short confirmation than a long emotional reply, but sends thoughtful check-ins when Shoba is stressed.

shared_activities: coordinating children's school and activity schedules
managing household bills and mortgage planning
phone and WhatsApp coordination with his parents in New Jersey
attending temple, weddings, and community events
recent_text_topics: Maya's college applications, school forms, deadlines, and campus-visit logistics.
Pickup schedules for Neel's robotics and basketball, especially when Shoba's shift runs late.
Budgeting around dental bills, groceries, and whether to delay furniture or travel spending.
Checking in about Shoba's parents' appointments and Rajesh's parents' health updates in New Jersey.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Shoba is married to Rajesh, he works as an IT systems analyst for an auto supplier, and they balance each other. Q44 says she told Rajesh when she was overwhelmed and he took over school forms for a few days. Q46 says Rajesh worries quietly about money and his parents. Q55 says Rajesh and Shoba share household expenses.

social_circle.name: Nisha Desai

background.how_they_met: They met through South Asian dance and Indian Association volunteer work, especially around Navratri planning.
background.why_close: They share Gujarati community ties, festival volunteering, practical family responsibilities, and an honest friendship style where Nisha gives Shoba direct emotional support.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts frequently and informally, often in quick bursts. Uses WhatsApp, occasional Gujarati phrases, laughing emojis, and blunt but caring advice.

shared_activities: coffee, museum visits, and restaurant outings
recent_text_topics: Volunteer schedule gaps for upcoming festival events and who can cover food tables.
Shoba's stress about her father's diabetes scare, Maya's college deadlines, and work staffing shortages.
Restaurant ideas, museum outings, and quick coffee plans when both have time.
Running joke that Shoba tries to be heroic with homemade meals when pizza would solve the evening.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Nisha is probably Shoba's closest friend, they organize Navratri volunteer schedules together, and talk almost every day. Q44 says Shoba called Nisha while overwhelmed and Nisha told her to order pizza and stop being heroic. Q49 says real emotional support comes from private texts, phone calls, or WhatsApp groups.

social_circle.name: Maya Mehta

demographics.education: Currently completing high school with advanced classes

background.how_they_met: Maya is Shoba and Rajesh's older child.
background.why_close: They share a home, artistic interests, cultural community work, and the emotional transition of Maya preparing to leave for college.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Fast, casual teen texting with screenshots, links, and occasional short replies when busy. More likely than Shoba to send visual drafts, social media posts, and deadline reminders.

recent_text_topics: College essay edits, application deadlines, campus visits, and financial or scheduling questions.
Design drafts for Indian Association or cultural-event social media flyers.
After-school timing, snacks, laundry, and whether she will be home for dinner.
Conversations about race, social justice, and how to respond to unfair comments online or at school.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Maya is 17, artistic, takes advanced classes, and helps Shoba with social media flyers for community events. Q18 says Maya's college applications changed the household rhythm with essays, campus visits, and deadlines. Q30 says Maya is engaged with social justice issues online.

social_circle.name: Neel Mehta

background.how_they_met: Neel is Shoba and Rajesh's younger child.
background.why_close: They live together, and Shoba coordinates his food, school, robotics, basketball, chores, and transportation reminders.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, functional texts with minimal punctuation. Often asks for rides, food, schedule details, or permission; uses memes or one-word replies more than long explanations.

shared_activities: home chores like trash, table clearing, and watering herbs
recent_text_topics: Pickup times from basketball practice and robotics club.
After-school snacks like eggs, thepla, or peanut butter toast.
Whether he can bike to a nearby friend's house and when to be home.
Reminders about chores, homework, and helping set up chairs for festival events.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Neel is 14 and into robotics and basketball. Q19 describes his school routine, robotics club, basketball practice, and Shoba's role in morning food and schedule reminders. Q11 says Neel takes out trash, clears the table, and helps water herbs. Q09 says Shoba lets him bike to a friend's house nearby.

social_circle.name: Amit Patel

demographics.occupation: operations manager for an automotive supplier
demographics.education: Some college and professional operations training

background.how_they_met: Amit is Shoba's younger brother; they grew up together in Farmington Hills in a Gujarati immigrant household.
background.why_close: They are close siblings who see each other regularly and divide responsibilities for their aging parents. Their shared upbringing makes their communication practical, teasing, and direct.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Casual sibling texting with jokes, short updates, and logistics. Likely uses WhatsApp or SMS for parent-care coordination, with occasional Gujarati family shorthand.

shared_activities: paperwork, driving, repairs, and food planning for parents
recent_text_topics: Who will drive their father to diabetes or heart-related appointments and who will handle paperwork.
Food ideas for their father's diabetes-friendly meals that still feel like normal Gujarati home cooking.
Summer barbecue or holiday plans with their children and cousins.
Light teasing about who inherited more of their father's detail-oriented habits.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Shoba has a younger brother Amit in Novi, they are close, tease each other, and see each other at least twice a month. Q06 and Q35 say Shoba handles more appointments and food while Amit handles repairs, paperwork, and driving for their parents. Q99 says they grew up together.
